newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss June trade surplus revised down. [CORRECTED 11:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Swiss June trade surplus revised down. [CORRECTED 11:55 GMT]

text.p: Switzerland's trade surplus in June was revised to 329.7 million Swiss francs from a provisional figure of 334.3 million, the Federal Customs Office said.
It gave these revised figures for June:

Provisional figures had shown imports of 8,614.0 million and exports of 8,948.4 million Swiss francs. These figures exclude trade in precious metals, precious stones, art objects and antiques. -- Zurich Newsroom, +41-1-631 7340
